scientific_integrity: Integral combinatorial Alexander duality, free simplicial collapses and explicit equivariant character calculation; same-model mathematical review only. No independent validation or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to simple graphs on at least seven vertices with no 3- or 4-cycles. The homotopy equivalence is not claimed to be group-equivariant, nor is shellability proved. Finite checker corroborates examples only; the theorem relies on an integral argument. Alternative literature coverage remains a residual originality risk.
title: Three-cut complexes of graphs without short cycles: sphere wedges and symmetry characters
